sourceMetadata.name: flagship-star-baked-age-wave
sourceMetadata.ageFormula: round(4.5 + 4.5*sin(2*pi*((band-firstBand)/(bandCount-1) + serial/96))); outside the section age=0
sourceMetadata.phase: Initial blank serial0 has phase0; advance once on each film-image commit, modulo96.
sourceMetadata.startup: Stored composites0..9 retain the real initially blank history. Only serial0 is entirely blank; history fills gradually.
sourceMetadata.repeatingSuffix: Composites10..105: latest source poses10..96,1..9, with phase10..95,0..9. Composite106 exactly reproduces composite10.

approximation.matcher: Existing createMatcher(lockedFont,true), minimum 8x8 Hamming error; ties choose the lowest glyph code. No object-mask constraint.
approximation.comparisonReference: Ideal2-raster-band mix of already decoded source glyph bitmaps; errors are additional to the original three.js-to-font conversion.

scope: Host-generated ordinary character film and exact original global skip/literal compression. Native FPS has not been measured for this new movie.
